source: Department of Finance, Statistical Profiles of New York City Business Income Taxes, Tax Year 2022 (August 2026), highlights p. 1
basis: Liability by industry, from the Department of Finance statistical profiles. Tax owed for 2022, not fiscal-year revenue.
coverage: Business corporation, general corporation and unincorporated business taxes only. Those lines were $11,028,201 thousand of the group's $14,119,409 thousand in fiscal 2025 (78%); the pass-through entity, utility and smaller taxes in the group have no sector data.
caption: Tax year 2022 liability for the business corporation, general corporation and unincorporated business taxes. These three taxes were 78% of this group in fiscal 2025; the pass-through entity, utility and smaller taxes in it have no sector data.

quotes.top1: The top 1 percent of taxpayers, or 1,912 firms, accounted for $4.24 billion, or 93 percent of total liability. (Business Corporation Tax, highlights p.1)
